selected_evidence.requirement: Existing /srv/inventory data ownership repaired to inventorysvc:inventory-readers with correct access (owner full, group read, others none), contents preserved
selected_evidence.summary: Initial inspection showed root:root ownership and no inventorysvc user or inventory-readers group. After creating both and applying chown -R + chmod (750 dirs / 640 files), verification listing shows inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership with 750/640 modes, and cat of records.csv/config.json shows original data intact.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 healthy baseline captured before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 4ebdfa06-919e-48a9-8a15-475d9007662c, uptime -s, permission listing (inventorysvc:inventory-readers 750/640), and sha256 checksums of records.csv and config.json prior to reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sleep 2; sudo -n reboot' via setsid so the exec call returned 'reboot scheduled' immediately, before the node went down.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart proven via changed boot identity, then recovery polled
selected_evidence.summary: First poll still showed old boot_id (reboot not yet triggered); next two polls timed out/connection-reset confirming the node was down; final poll succeeded with new boot_id 9e1e5dce-2b48-4610-a68e-dbe3e1b2c60e, proving an actual restart occurred (not just elapsed time).

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required state (ownership, permissions, data integrity, user/group persistence)
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart check shows /srv/inventory still owned inventorysvc:inventory-readers with 750/640 modes, sha256 checksums of both data files unchanged from baseline, and getent confirms inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group persisted across reboot.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== create group inventory-readers =="
sudo -n groupadd inventory-readers
echo "== create user inventorysvc =="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /sbin/nologin inventorysvc
echo "== chown recursively =="
sudo -n chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
echo "== chmod dirs 750 =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type d -exec chmod 750 {} \;
echo "== chmod files 640 =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type f -exec chmod 640 {} \;
echo "== verify =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -exec ls -ld {} \;
echo "== contents preserved =="
sudo -n cat /srv/inventory/data/records.csv
sudo -n cat /srv/inventory/data/config.json
